patterns.title: Backtracking
patterns.description: Explore choices, undo them, and let constraints prune the search tree.
patterns.explanation: Backtracking fits problems where each decision opens a smaller recursive subproblem.

problems.title: Subsets

notes.intuition: Each element has two choices: take it or leave it.
notes.whyPattern: Backtracking naturally records a path and unwinds to try the next choice.

problems.approach: Run DFS from an index, add the current path to the answer, and try each remaining element.
